verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a Better Auth audit-log capability, tamper-evident storage, or any streaming or export path to a SIEM. The homepage's sample activity feed ("Johncreated a session" and similar) is an unexplained marketing visual. The "Security & observability" line covers bot detection and IP blocking, not audit logging, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can capture tamper-evident audit logs of authentication and admin activity and stream or export them to my SIEM
